Highest diploma, including senior high school diploma or bachelor’s degree certificate needed in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.9. Academic transcripts: Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.10.Stamped Transcript from the undergraduate/master program or notarized Chinese/English-translated transcript.11. A study or research plan. Applicants for postgraduate degrees are required to submit a study or research plan in Chinese or in English.12.Recommendation letters: Applicants for postgraduate studies must submit two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors.13.Valid HSK Transcript for Chinese-taught programs and IELTS\TOEFL for English-taught programs, or other documents to prove your linguistic competence.
